history_summary: Record native species-reference correspondence for the A1 PAH isolate baseline.
history_details: The A1 species descriptor receives native Bacillus_A paranthracis correspondence from a 210-genome reference population with rounded majority fraction 0.99. The reference population is not an exact stock assembly, exact majority numerator or experimental abundance. Preserve the separate A1 isolate baseline, source-reported 16S markers and retained assignment/genotype uncertainty, seven-day HPLC removal evidence, planktonic/static-biofilm contrast and all original PAH/source limitations. Bacillus_A is a GTDB lineage label difference, not formal stock renaming. Issues 2317-2319 and all earlier scientific findings remain separate. Only one selected GTDB block/status and two native inline events changed. The pinned table has no verified upstream release label. All prior history remains unchanged; this bounded technical correction does not complete scientific review or corpus QC.
